package.name: udl_aa_seqs
package.description:
Flight sequences for the ArduPilot autonomy stack. The executive layer: multi-step phase machines composed on top of the stateless command/status interface exposed by the flight stack, determining step completion from telemetry since the vehicle side never reports it.
Holds the sequences and the link to the flight stack, and nothing that decides which sequence should run - that intent arrives from above. Split out of udl_aa_fc so a sequence exists once rather than once per commander, and so a sequence that blocks cannot stall whatever is arbitrating over it.
